decisions.actualExistingActions: e3c70a12 supplies orthogonal coordinate-plane map and checks one projection/linearity/image/kernel; 81823f27 uses two-dimensional matrices and a coordinate-axis projection; Solardach computes one shadow line-plane intersection and a normal, without deriving a 3D arbitrary-origin-plane matrix.
decisions.judgment: No found whole form determines and analyzes the oblique projection matrix on an arbitrary origin plane. New content is justified as a role-neutral option; no existing form modified.

decisions.actualExistingActions: Affine A1 solves two-dimensional nonzero-translation fixed sets, distinguishes invariant/fixed lines; CAD discusses one point fixed under an axis half-turn inside a reflection task; 81823f27 checks a 2D eigenvector and image points.
decisions.judgment: Neither is the original required 3D linear Ax=x system solution for all fixed points. Keep the affine, reflection and eigenvector obligations separate; no assumed transfer through title or coverage labels.

decisions.actualExistingActions: e3c70a12 actually calculates the supplied P(v)=(2,-1,0), orthogonal rest, and interprets coordinate plane/image and perpendicular line/kernel, plus linearity. Software cuboid task creates two actual software views and explains vanished dimensions; it has its own real artifact obligation.
decisions.judgment: e3c70a12 is a genuine reviewed whole-task reuse alternative to investigate for the point-and-geometric-interpretation reading of the original description, which says points/lines/surfaces/objects OR, not AND. Do not require every object type as new separate mastery. Existing e3 applicability excludes BY and its original R does not reach this goal. The new multi-view form remains optional content for a later reviewed route choice; it is not an automatic extra obligation or blanket replacement. Never waive the separate software artifact requirement.
decisions.laterDecision: Independent whole-content review should explicitly decide whether the supplied-rule point projection plus interpretation is sufficient in each compatible scope; choose a reusable existing route where it is, rather than imposing both. BY and any scope/preparation changes require separate review.
decisions.warning: Declarative 15-jurisdiction e3 applicability is not actual membership of the coordinate competency. Actual overlap is 12 HE scopes; 4 BY scopes are distinct. A global e3->574 edge would affect 120 further existing exam scopes without the currently complete preparation context and is not approved.

decisions.actualExistingActions: Solardach solution uses a cross product as one permissible way to find a normal, but the task neither explicitly requires it nor assesses a cross-product magnitude for area. The pyramid task uses a perpendicular triangle area and volume; no cross product is demanded.
decisions.judgment: Normal-only example or area arithmetic via perpendicular sides is not the whole explicitly joined cross-product applications to normals and areas. New content is justified; no claim that prerequisite definition/normal/area competencies are separately mastered.
